node.name: footer · data statement
node.chars: Data: synthetic only — a seeded BTCUSDT book (seed 440): tick 0.10 and qty step 0.001 from the recorded instrument fixture; mark 64,012.5; 500 levels a side with seeded gaps; rows at a 10 USDT zoom; 60 trail columns of 1 s to 00:12:19 UTC; sizes, walls, prints, stops, the own orders and position, the accounts "Acct A" and "Acct B" and the viewing-as user "Manager 01" are synthetic. No real account identifier, key or balance. The env badge reads the session environment (DEMO on this board), never the feed (C-2.11).

value-1.chars: §4 L222 SCR-050/streaming: signal book and heatmap frames applying; shows the full anatomy; follow state "Following"; keyboard §9; announced W-29 polite once on return from stale or resyncing (D02E17:257); T2 §5 notice and legs

value-2.chars: Tab order (§9.1): 1-4 header controls (depth, view switch, follow toggle, ⋯; scale, trail, cell and ARM inside ⋯ at 1280 px) → 5 heatmap pane (one stop, role="img") → 6 ladder grid (one stop, roving rows) → 7 footer → 8 detector strip; Ctrl+\ cycles regions; initial focus the grid at the mark's row

value-3.chars: Enter on a row opens the row menu as `14`:1217 words it (C-4): limit, stop, TP T2 2a on W-20, then alert here and copy price enabled; focus on the first item; Esc returns focus to the row

value-4.chars: The ring color.focus.ring, 2 px, outside the 24 px row box, never under the sticky header or footer (§9.3)

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: `Ladder │ Table` (Alt+T) in the never-overflow set; a Viewer sees it; neither view is an alternative or a fallback — both are views of one panel; the same T2 notice

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Windowed with `05`'s keyboard-operable, focus-preserving "load more rows" (`05`:195): the 500 tier's rows 201–500 reachable; `05` stopping at 200 is G-2; the heatmap table PROPOSED (G-4); checklist item 5 open

value-1.chars: Drawn in CSS px (640 × 400 = the 1280 × 800 frame at 200 %); the header keeps title · depth · env badge · view switch · follow toggle · ⋯ (two rows); the notice wraps, never clipped; the footer wraps to two rows

value-2.chars: The pane hides behind the Heatmap toggle (native button, aria-pressed, just before the pane's stop), the reveal still reachable; Prints and Cum. depth move to the row reveal

value-3.chars: At 400 % (320 CSS px) the header, notice and footer reflow to one column; the grid scrolls horizontally inside itself (the data-table exception); the Table view stacks per row — not drawn, the text is binding

kids.name: value-1

kit choice: the heatmap pane draws one row per ladder row (R-2) and one column per trail second (the cell chip's auto = 1 s), equal-stop runs drawn as one rect; compact and comfortable cells keep a 1 px gutter top and bottom, the cosy (`dense`) pane none (§3.1 'the pane's gutters tighter')

kit choice: menus and the open listbox drawn as color.surface.overlay cards with a 1 px color.border.default outline (popovers over the rows)
